individualProductPageChecks.method: Opened each official localized product URL individually; used the primary purchase CTA. Where an add-to-basket CTA and a contact-a-boutique option coexist, classified as listed.

observations.scope: All 546 active references already present before the 2026-10-11 new listings, plus the same-day direct PDP evidence for all 17 newly listed references (total 563 active listing references).
observations.source: Official localized Omega product detail URLs loaded sequentially with a real browser context fetch; returned PDP HTML fields were cross-checked against rendered storefront UI on representative ES pages. No cookies or tokens were stored.
observations.method: Extract exact reference, regional title, displayed EUR amount, add-to-cart form presence, and Contact a Boutique action. A present cart CTA counts as listed even if disabled until required options are selected. No cart CTA plus an official Contact a Boutique CTA and displayed price counts as retailer-only.

failedAndRecoveredRequests.method: same-origin browser-context fetch from original isolated ES context
failedAndRecoveredRequests.retry: Fresh isolated Chrome context; selected España via the official region/language selector; retry returned HTTP 200, matching reference, EUR price and purchase CTA.
